title: Costs
subtitle: What each machine, site and season cost, and what rentals brought in.
laborHidden: Labour cost is hidden for managers in this organisation. Totals exclude labour.

seasonMissing.title: Some costs have no season
seasonMissing.body: They are counted under "No season". Older records may show "Choose a season for this cost"; you can set the season on the job or rental.

empty.title: No costs in this period
empty.body: Completed jobs and closed rentals appear here. Try a wider date range.
